items.followUp: Explain two ways encryption helps protect an online banking account.

rubric.description: Explains that encryption changes readable information into coded form.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that readable information is converted into coded form.

rubric.why: Shows that encryption protects sensitive information.
rubric.description: Mentions that encryption protects private or sensitive information, such as passwords or personal data.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming private information or a relevant example.

rubric.why: Explains protection from people who should not access the information.
rubric.description: States that encryption helps prevent unauthorized people from accessing or misusing information.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning protection against unauthorized access.

rubric.why: Connects encryption to an everyday Internet activity.
rubric.description: Gives a relevant use of encryption, such as online banking or Internet transactions.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a relevant everyday example.

modelAnswer: Encryption converts readable information into coded form so that others cannot easily understand it.
It protects private information, such as passwords and personal data, when it is sent over the Internet.
It helps prevent unauthorized people from accessing or misusing this information.
It is important for secure everyday activities such as online banking and other Internet transactions.
